item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
New

  • The readout is now a running clock that shows the timecode right now, using the same decoder and clock as SMPTE Notes
  • Pick which input channel carries the timecode (earlier versions could only read channel 1)
  • The frame rate is detected from the timecode; the frame rate setting is gone
  • Art-Net timecode output for grandMA3 consoles and onPC, sent to everyone on a chosen network or to one address, with a stream ID
  • Separate switches for the MIDI timecode and Art-Net timecode outputs
  • The app remembers the input device and channel, and keeps trying if the device is not ready yet

Fixes

  • MIDI timecode goes out on the timecode's own frame boundaries instead of one to two frames late
  • When the timecode stops, receivers are parked on the frame it stopped on

macOS asks for Microphone access again after this update, and for Local Network access the first time Art-Net is sent to another machine.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
Fixes

  • Correct MTC timing — quarter-frames now sent at the spec rate with properly latched sequences, so downstream receivers track smoothly
  • Full-frame cue messages on chase start and timecode jumps (drop-frame aware)
  • Signal-loss watchdog — on LTC dropout the app drops lock and stops MTC output instead of freewheeling stale timecode, and re-cues automatically when signal returns
  • Sample rate follows the input device automatically; the manual picker (which could decode at the wrong speed) is gone
  • Auto-update restored — v1.0.1 shipped without Sparkle keys and could never update itself
  • Start failures now show an error dialog instead of failing silently

New

  • Apple-native UI redesign and the app's first icon
